metadata.description: Guard mods from slopless. Each one ships with its own tests.

plugins.name: secrets-guard
plugins.description: Denies writes to secret files and writes whose content carries a credential, with the reason shown.

plugins.name: read-first
plugins.description: Clears the engine's 'File has not been read yet' error: Edit reads the file and retries; Write hands the model the file's head with the error.

plugins.name: rollback-notice
plugins.description: When a gate denies a Bash call, tells the model the whole call was rolled back and must be re-run in full; refuses git commit -F from shared /tmp.

plugins.name: delegation-drift
plugins.description: Counts main-thread work since the last subagent dispatch, nudges the model to delegate at every tenth call, and refuses foreground poll loops.
